reasons: All 26 nodes pass against the review-fixed implementation on the branch rebased onto origin/main, with no loss of coverage versus the inherited baseline.

AC 4 is no longer partial. The inherited artifact flagged its submit-time half as asserted only indirectly; review comment 3921202954 caused that path to be removed, so what remains is exactly the stream-driven behaviour the recipe does assert.

The three copy-variant frames were re-captured and each was inspected, not just counted: all three render the reviewer-requested taker wording with Place order enabled, which is the check that caught defects on the original authoring run.
better_version_guidance: Drive the endpoint values from the live top-of-book instead of hardcoding prices around BTC's current level, so the recipe does not silently degrade if BTC moves far from ~77k. Carried forward unaddressed from the inherited artifact.

The at-the-touch equality case that review comment 3921202930 fixed is not reachable through this recipe, which types round prices against a live market. It is covered by unit tests instead. A recipe that read best ask into a param and typed exactly that value would close the gap end-to-end.

coverage.reason: All five acceptance criteria have at least one dedicated assertion node. AC 4 is covered on both the endpoint-edit and side-flip axes, and its previously unasserted submit half no longer exists in the implementation.

graph_quality.reason: Unchanged from the inherited recipe apart from three assertion strings. Linear graph with an explicit direction reset after navigation, so the run does not inherit leftover form state.

evidence_fit.reason: Mixed proof: assertions for every claim plus a re-captured screenshot per copy variant. Each frame was read and confirmed to show the new wording, the endpoints, the justifying market price, and an enabled Place order control.

flake_risk.reason: Endpoint prices remain hardcoded around BTC ~77k. A large move would put the chosen values on the wrong side of the book and flip assertions. Acceptable for a branch gate; would need live-price parameterisation for CI. Unchanged from the inherited artifact.

failing_first.reason: Established on the family root run by stashing the implementation, restarting the app onto that source, and re-running: fail at expect-partial-above with present=false. Not re-executed this round; the review fixes narrowed the helper's behaviour rather than introducing the feature, and the assertion nodes that failed without it are unchanged.

contextual_findings.message: The inclusive at-the-touch comparison from review comment 3921202930 cannot be exercised by this recipe, which types round prices against a moving live market. Eight unit tests cover the boundary in both directions instead. Recorded so the gap is explicit rather than assumed covered by the green run.

Resolves the inherited submit_path_not_asserted finding. The submit-time re-check was removed rather than made assertable: it read the same committed snapshot that produced the price-card message and only wrote a DevLogger line, so it observed no new state.

expect-quiet passes in both worlds because the message element is absent with and without the feature. Retained deliberately as a guard against over-warning, not counted as feature proof. Carried forward from the inherited artifact.

Three ui.wait_for nodes assert on literal user-facing copy, so the reviewer-requested rewording in comment 3921202951 required editing the recipe alongside the locale file. Text-only edit; node IDs, ordering, testIDs, intents, and screenshot nodes untouched.

suggested_recipe_delta: Read the live best bid/ask into params and derive the endpoint values from it instead of hardcoding prices near 77k.
Add a node that types exactly the live best ask as an endpoint, so the inclusive at-the-touch behaviour is proved in the app and not only in unit tests.

anti_patterns: Treating a green end-to-end run as evidence that a comparison operator is correct. All 26 nodes passed with a strict > that mislabelled an at-the-touch endpoint as resting, because a UI recipe never types boundary values.
Falling back to an approximate reference (mid) to keep a warning always-available. It converts an absent answer into a confident wrong one on a claim about the user's money.
Reusing a shipped locale string in a new semantic context without checking the blast radius: fifteen locales already carried translations, so the wording could not be corrected in place.
good_patterns: Re-running the inherited recipe against branch plus origin/main rather than authoring a new one, so the node count is directly comparable to the baseline.
Reading every re-captured frame after a copy change instead of trusting the exit code.
Removing an unobservable code path when the reviewer offers removal as an option, rather than building plumbing to make a dev-only log assertable.
